notes: v5.6 - EMERGENCY HOTFIX: if your Nalox Aura panel disappeared from Window > Extensions after updating to v5.4 or v5.5, this update brings it back. The v5.4/v5.5 manifest file was invalid (a changelog comment contained a double hyphen, which XML comments may not contain), so After Effects silently skipped the extension while the installer reported success. The manifest is now clean, and every future release is verified by an automated XML check before it ships. Also: INSTALL.bat and UNINSTALL.bat now stop with a clear message if After Effects is still running, instead of risking a half-deleted install. If your panel is already gone, download v5.6 from the website and run INSTALL.bat with After Effects closed. Everything else is exactly v5.5, including the Clipping tab. Your settings, keys and PRO unlock carry over.
